constraints: Pass exactly one of filePath or fileObj to designate the destination, not both.
If filePath contains only a document name (no path), the file is saved at the same level as the 4D structure file.
If format is omitted, it is inferred from the file extension given in filePath/fileObj.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Exports wpDoc to a document on disk designated by a text file path.
Exports wpDoc to a document on disk designated by a 4D.File object.
